_readme: Real, direct parish-level mid-2021 population estimates for Cholsey and all 8 confirmed comparators (Q-009), from ONS's own ad-hoc 'Parish population estimates for mid-2021, based on best-fitting of output areas to parishes' release -- the standard ONS method for parish-level population, since parish is not a native census output geography. Unlike P1.4/P1.5/the census-day OA counts above, this dataset already covers every parish nationally, so no per-comparator OA lookup was needed -- see ADR-0005 and the P1.6 worklog entry.

_provenance.title: Parish population estimates for mid-2021, based on best-fitting of output areas to parishes
_provenance.vintage: mid-2021 (30 June 2021), rebased to Census 2021, PAR22 (2022 parish edition) boundaries
_provenance.method: Downloaded the ONS 'Parish Populations' worksheet and read the 'Total' column for each of the 9 relevant GSS codes.
_provenance.flag: This is a mid-year (30 June 2021) modelled estimate, not the Census Day (21 March 2021) headcount -- Cholsey's figure here (4404) differs from both spec §2's 4,498 and this project's own OA-best-fit Census Day computation (4390, see oa_census_counts_cholsey_area.json) by a few percent. All three are legitimate but different vintages/methods; see ADR-0005.
